subject: Bellwether pilot: deployment mode qualification + pilot plan
body:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Annika Gomez <annika@bellwether.com>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@bellwether.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bellwether pilot: deployment mode qualification + pilot plan

Thanks again for the call earlier — great discussion and appreciate the context on regulatory needs and latency expectations. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment.

Key points from call:
- Primary security constraint: PHI in inference flow; Bellwether requires SOC2 evidence and KMS integration.
- Latency/throughput: target P99 < 250ms for inference flows, expected steady-state 80–120 QPS for the pilot.
- Integration surface: REST API frontend, HashiCorp Vault/KMS for keys, internal VPC peering preferred.
- Procurement: procurement timeline is ~6–8 weeks for on-prem/VPC contracts, shorter for hosted/dedicated.

Options discussed (high level):
1) Private (VPC / on-prem) — best for PHI and auditability, longer procurement and network work.
2) Dedicated capacity — predictable throughput, faster time-to-test, can be isolated to Bellwether but still managed in our cloud.
3) Hosted API — fastest to validate core model functionality but requires tokenization controls and stronger contractual guarantees for PHI (less ideal).

Proposed pragmatic path (asks in order of priority):
- Short-term: run a 6-week pilot that focuses on functional validation and performance tests. Start on Dedicated to get running quickly, then migrate to Private VPC for final acceptance if procurement requires it.
- Deliverables we’ll provide before kickoff: draft SOW, week-by-week runbook, pilot success criteria spreadsheet, and network requirements doc.
- We need your technical lead and security contact to start the SOC2 questionnaire and provide any internal firewall/UAM contacts.

Attachments: [Attachment: pilot_success_criteria.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)], [Attachment: bellwether_network_requirements.docx (DOCX, 24KB)]

Next steps for this week:
- Annika: confirm security contact + procurement timeline estimate.
- Bellwether platform team: share any network diagrams and firewall windows.
- Redwood: send draft SOW and a proposed 6-week pilot schedule by Monday.

Thanks — will follow up with concrete dates once we have your procurement window.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0191

From: Annika Gomez <annika@bellwether.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@bellwether.com>, Bellwether Platform Team <platform@bellwether.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bellwether pilot: deployment mode qualification + pilot plan

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side so we can move quickly: 

1) Security/compliance: PHI is in-scope for inference; we need full KMS integration, audit logs (retention 1 year), and the ability to route logs to our SIEM. SOC2 evidence will be required for the private option.

2) Timeline: procurement for Private VPC will likely take 8+ weeks (legal + infra approvals). Procurement for Dedicated (standalone reserved capacity) could be faster — maybe 2–3 weeks if we sign the term sheet. We're open to your Dedicated-first then Private migration approach, provided the SOW and cost delta are clear.

3) Success criteria: we want to see the P99 latency expectation validated at scale, deterministic KV cache behavior for longer sessions, and an end-to-end data handling proof (how we can ensure PHI never leaves our VPC in the Private option).

Can you circulate the draft SOW and the week-by-week plan? Also share an estimated cost delta between Dedicated and Private for a 6-week trial (ballpark is fine).

—Annika
Annika Gomez
Head of Platform Engineering | Bellwether Health
annika@bellwether.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bellwether pilot: internal action items and pricing guidance

Following Annika's reply — internal notes and recommended approach: 

- Proposed pilot structure (6 weeks):
  Week 0 (kickoff): network onboarding, credentials/KMS exchange, baseline test harness install.
  Week 1–2: functional validation on Dedicated (endpoints, auth, simple workloads).
  Week 3–4: performance ramp & P99 latency testing (up to 120 QPS sustained).
  Week 5: compliance/checklist runthrough, log delivery + SIEM integration test.
  Week 6: acceptance window and migration plan to Private if needed.

- Owners:
  Redwood AE: Diego Fernandez (commercial owner)
  Redwood SE: Monica Patel (technical lead)
  Redwood Product: Priyom Das (pilot success & acceptance criteria)
  Bellwether: Annika Gomez (platform), Tom Reeves (procurement)

- Pricing note: recommend we provide a two-part quote: (a) Dedicated trial price for 6 weeks (includes reserved slice + support) and (b) estimated uplift for Private deployment (infra + setup fee). Offer a 10% credit if they commit to a 12-week reserved capacity within 30 days.

- Security: ask Security team to pre-fill SOC2 questionnaire and offer our encryption/KMS integration docs; Priyom, can you prepare a short note on how KV caching works with Private VPC?

Monica

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Annika Gomez <annika@bellwether.com>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@bellwether.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bellwether pilot: deployment mode qualification + pilot plan

Annika / Tom — appreciate the quick reply and clarity on procurement timing. We can proceed with the Dedicated-first pilot transitioning to Private once procurement completes. Summary of agreed next actions and deliverables: 

1) Redwood actions (by EOD Tue):
   - Share draft SOW + week-by-week runbook. [Attachment: draft_statement_of_work_v1.pdf]
   - Provide ballpark pricing (Dedicated 6-week trial + Private uplift and setup).
   - Security docs: SOC2 evidence summary + KMS integration guide, and pre-filled questionnaire.

2) Bellwether actions:
   - Share security contact and procurement timeline estimate (Annika).
   - Provide network diagrams and whitelist windows (platform@bellwether.com).

3) Kickoff: propose Tue 2027-04-26 10:00 PT for a 45-min kickoff (network, credentials, owners). Please confirm availability.

4) Success criteria (high level) — we will publish detailed metrics in the SOW but top-level:
   - P99 inference latency < 250ms at target QPS (validated week 3–4)
   - End-to-end data control verification (KMS integration + logs delivered to Bellwether SIEM)
   - Throughput: ability to sustain 80–120 QPS on the Dedicated slice during ramp tests
   - No functional regressions across the test prompts (sample set to be shared)

Attachments included in this thread: [Attachment: pilot_success_criteria.xlsx], [Attachment: bellwether_network_requirements.docx], [Attachment: draft_statement_of_work_v1.pdf]

If that all looks good, please reply with the security contact and confirm the kickoff time. We'll aim to have commercial terms for the Dedicated trial in the kickoff packet.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
"diego@redwood.ai" | +1 (415) 555-0191
